{{Recipe}}

'''Nigerian tomato omelette''' is a simple dish of egg and tomato.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Egg|Eggs]]
* [[Cookbook:Tomato|Tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Stovetop|Stove]]
* [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]]
* [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|Frying pan]]
* Bowls
* [[Cookbook:Spatula|Spatula]]

== Procedure ==

# Heat some oil in a pan over high heat. Add the tomatoes, and fry until well-heated. 
# [[Cookbook:Mixing|Beat]] the eggs, and stir in the cooked tomato. Return the mixture to the pan over medium-low heat, making sure it is evenly spread across the pan. Cook until the egg is sturdy enough to flip.
# Flip the omelette to the other side, and cook until the bottom is golden.
# Serve hot with bread or jollof rice.
